attorney.label: Attorney Leadership
attorney.name: Dr. Eyad Al-Samhan
attorney.body1: Dr. Eyad Al-Samhan is an immigration and business attorney with an academic and professional background spanning international law, constitutional law, and cross-border legal matters.
attorney.body2: He holds a doctorate in international and constitutional law, awarded with highest honors (summa cum laude), and a Master of Laws (LL.M.) from Brigham Young University in the United States.
attorney.body3: He leads all legal strategy, case evaluation, and final review at Cabral Alsamhan PLLC.
practice.title: Practice Focus
practice.subtitle: Our work is concentrated across key areas of U.S. immigration law.
practice.business.desc: Advising founders, investors, executives, and established companies on strategic U.S. immigration pathways, cross-border business planning, and long-term mobility matters.
practice.immigration.desc: Representing individuals and families in immigration matters with careful case analysis, tailored legal strategy, and direct attorney oversight at every stage.

team.mohammad_alkurdi.name: Mohammad Alkurdi
team.mohammad_alkurdi.desc: Mohammad Alkurdi is a legal and human rights professional. He worked as a Human Rights Analyst at the Amman Centre for Human Rights, where he contributed research and analysis on regional human rights issues. He also gained professional experience with the United States Embassy in Jordan and worked with the Crown Prince Foundation in Amman, contributing to initiatives focused on youth development and community engagement. Mohammad is particularly interested in human rights, immigration matters, and international legal systems.
team.thayrine.name: Thayrine Ferreira Prado
team.thayrine.desc: I am a bilingual legal and education professional from Brazil, with experience as an Immigration Paralegal handling U.S. immigration matters and as an English teacher. My background includes legal documentation, client communication, case preparation, and educational instruction. I am detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable working in multicultural and professional environments.
team.limia.name: Limia Bahar
team.limia.desc: Limia Bahar is a motivated and detail-oriented professional with a strong background in management and customer service, currently pursuing a degree in Criminal Justice with a minor in IT. She has hands-on experience in technical support and troubleshooting, combined with excellent communication and problem-solving skills, making her well-suited for an IT Support Specialist role.
